message: Last summer, we had a sudden blackout, and my friend who always panics started searching for candles, which I gently reminded her are not the best idea. Instead, we gathered our flashlights and power banks, and I found it surprisingly cozy to huddle together with snacks and a lantern. It’s funny how a little prep can turn a stressful moment into an unexpected adventure. Have you ever had a blackout that turned into a memorable night?
